source_note: GitHub's Spec Kit v1.0.6 (pinned tag, commit d56d883): the with side's overlay is exactly what `specify init --here --force --non-interactive --integration claude` wrote into a copy of base/frai on 21 Sep 2026 (.claude/skills/speckit-* and .specify/; v1.0.6 names the skills with a dash, /speckit-specify, not the dot form in older docs). With: four steps in one resumed session: /speckit-specify <task text>, then /speckit-plan, /speckit-tasks, /speckit-implement. Constitution and clarify skipped, as in the brief. Without: day 11's plan side (plan mode, then 'The plan is approved. Implement it now.'). Skills and slash commands on for both sides, Spec Kit's helper scripts and git checkout/branch allowed on both sides, 30-minute cap per run (Spec Kit writes more before it builds). Time, cost, turns and tokens summed over every step.

with.label: Spec Kit: specify, plan, tasks, implement

turns.prompt: The plan is approved. Implement it now.
